name: server-vitals
description: Single-file, zero-dependency host-monitoring agent (Python stdlib only). This package.json exists only to expose convenience scripts.

scripts.check: python3 -m py_compile server-vitals.py && echo "ok: server-vitals.py compiles"
scripts._release: V=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && sed -i "s/^VERSION = .*/VERSION = \"$V\"/" server-vitals.py && git add -A && git commit -m "v$V" && git tag "v$V" && git push && git push --tags && npm run deploy
scripts.publish:patch: bun check && npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && npm run _release
scripts.publish:minor: bun check && npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && npm run _release
scripts.publish:major: bun check && npm version major --no-git-tag-version && npm run _release
